content:
maria: Quick sync — release v2.9 cutoff is tomorrow 17:00 PT. Need to finalize changelog entries, SDK docs regen, and schedule the docs site deploy. Who can own the cutover checklist?

sarah: I can own the docs cutover. Plan is to stage the site at 16:45 PT, then full deploy at 17:30 PT once the release tag is created. I need final changelog blurbs by 16:15 PT to stage the banner and release notes.

ton y: SDK lead here — I’ll run the docs regen and publish the SDK docs. ETA: run regen at 16:20 PT, push artifacts to staging by 16:35 PT. Command I’ll use: `yarn regen-sdk-docs && yarn deploy-docs --env=staging`.

ev an: Platform note — please don't schedule docs deploys during the infra maintenance window (15:30-16:00 PT). If regen runs overlap, CI queue might delay.

maria: Good catch. Sarah — can you confirm staging build will be ready by 16:45 if Tony runs at 16:20?

sarah: Should be fine as long as CI passes. If something flakes, I can hold deploy until 17:40 but prefer 17:30 to keep parity with the SDK release.

ton y: I’ll watch the CI, pinging here when artifact upload completes. If regen fails on the py-docs script, I’ll fallback to the last-stable docs artifacts and add a note in the changelog.

jen: Product asks that the changelog callouts include the new routing policy note and a short rollback section. Copy: "Added cost-aware routing policy with graceful fallback; see rollback steps in ops guide." Please stage that under "Platform".

sarah: Got the copy, inserting under Platform. Anyone else with edits?

ev an: Ops guide reference — link needs to point to /docs/ops/rollbacks (new anchor is ready).

maria: Branch coordination: freeze release branches at 16:00 PT. No merges after that except emergency patches — tag will be created at 17:00 PT. Call out any pending PRs now.

ton y: One small SDK doc PR still open (PR #534). I’ll merge it by 15:50 PT. If CI shows any issues I’ll revert.

sarah: I found one minor API change in the docs staging preview that needs wording. I’ll push a tiny patch to the docs branch at 15:55 — should be fine.

maria: Perfect. Reminder: changelog finalization deadline 16:15 PT; branch freeze 16:00 PT; SDK regen 16:20 PT; staging preview 16:45 PT; tag cut 17:00 PT; docs deploy 17:30 PT.

deploy-bot: deploy-window locked 17:20-18:00 PT for team "release_ops" — auto-blockers enabled.

sarah: After deploy, I'll run smoke checks: homepage, SDK page, release notes banner, search indexing. If anything fails, we rollback docs to previous deploy and open a postmortem.

ev an: I'll keep an eye on logs for cache invalidation / CDN TTL — expect ~5-10m for global propagation.

maria: One last ask — if you tag the release, paste the tag link here and the changelog diff. I’ll assemble the release email.

ton y: Will post the tag link once I push (`git tag -a v2.9 -m "release v2.9" && git push origin v2.9`).

sarah: Staging preview URL: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/v2.9-preview (I'll update when artifacts available).

maria: Thanks everyone — let's use this thread for final ok/ko pings. :thumbsup:

ton y: merging SDK PR now.

sarah: small docs patch pushed at 15:56 PT. Preview building.

deploy-bot: ci/build #4821 succeeded (docs-regenerate). Artifacts uploaded to staging.

ton y: regen complete, artifacts uploaded at 16:34 PT.

sarah: staging preview up: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/v2.9-preview — please eyeball critical pages.

ev an: CDN purged for staging.

maria: changelog blurb received from product and merged. Finalizing release email.

sarah: smoke checks pass for core pages and SDK index. Ready for 17:30 deploy unless anyone objects.

jen: All good from product.

maria: OK — proceeding with cutover timeline. Will post tag link when available.

ton y: tag pushed: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/release/tag/v2.9

maria: Tag received. Publishing notes and kicking off deploy at 17:30. Good luck everyone! :party-parrot:
